THE PEOPLE WHO WALK WITH YOU

Guidance grounded
in understanding.

Our team brings spiritual maturity, verified training and lived experience to the work of helping people move forward. Each counselor walks with care, confidentiality and a commitment to seeing restoration take root.

OUR APPROACH

Counseling is not built on personal opinions. It calls for spiritual maturity, verified training and administrative discipline. Meet the people committed to walking with you through thoughtful, biblical models of clarity and restoration — patiently, privately and without judgment.

01CORM / COUNSELOR
Pastoring and Counseling

Pastor Collins Angel Ross

21 years in ministry, 7 years as a counselor.

Pastor Collins Angel Ross is a seasoned minister and counselor, and the Founder and Visionary Leader of College of Relationship & Marriage. As a married father of one daughter, Ps. Collins has dedicated his life to empowering individuals and families through his work. With a foundation in Accounting, Ps. Collins has leveraged his skills and experience to serve in ministry for 21 years and as a counselor for 7 years. He is also an itinerant minister who travels extensively in and out of Ghana, preaching the word with a strong prophetic and teaching anointing, and is a member of the International Central Gospel Church.

02CORM / COUNSELOR
Clergyman / Human Resources Manager

Rev. Blessed Ebenezer Otoo Tetteh

25 years pastoral experience.

Rev. Blessed Ebenezer Otoo Tetteh is a seasoned clergyman and human resources expert with over 25 years of pastoral experience. As the General Overseer and Snr Pastor of The Ambassador’s Haven Inc., Director of The Times Of Restitution and Refreshment Prayer Network (The Spirit-GYM) and Nexus Hub, he has demonstrated a deep commitment to spiritual leadership and community development. With a Certificate in Pastoral Studies from Restoration School of Ministry / Indiana Christian University, USA, and a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Human Resources Management from University College of Education, Winneba, Rev. Tetteh brings a unique blend of spiritual guidance and HR expertise to his ministry. As a married man celebrating 15 years of marriage, he is dedicated to serving others and providing leadership and mentorship to individuals and communities. With a priceless virtue of trustworthiness, commitment, selfless, consistency and promptness.
